LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)
Rundown subcooled -161.5 degC, 215 kPa(a) at the tanks (D-005). Top or bottom fill
from AI-1102 against the tank's density profile LTD-2103 / LTD-3103 (rollover, D-007).
ZSC-1102 / ZSC-1103 (both closed) and PZT-1105 (header high-high): C&E I-102. UZ-1115 (SIS vent): C&E I-203, I-303.
XV-1115: SIS, energise-to-trip with its own air accumulator (D-017). Thermal relief BOG-1004 / -1010 / -1011 into BOG-1001.
PIC-1110 / PIC-1111: split-range tank pressure control (D-017).
FO-1117: restriction orifice limiting the make-up flow (H-04 A1).
XV-1102, XV-1103, XV-1111..1114: closure at least 30 s (speed controller, non-return valve, air accumulator);
XS-1100 trips the trains' rundown as the closure starts (C&E I-101, I-102; D-023.3, D-028).
